h1: Custom Cardboard Crayons for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard crayons in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly and fully customizable for your brand.
introHtml: Cardboard crayons offer a sustainable alternative to plastic packaging, making them ideal for eco-conscious brands. These custom cardboard crayons are lightweight and easy to decorate with your logo using full-color printing. Perfect for school giveaways, trade shows, or children's event favors, the 10 Piece Crayon Box Set provides ample space for branding while the 4-In-1 Mini Highlighter Set adds functional variety. Choose cardboard for a natural, recyclable presentation that aligns with green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom cardboard crayons in a 10-piece box set with full-color logo printing for bulk orders
